scope: eight intended stepwise full-match pilot attempts; Stage A before Stage B
turn_bound: completed global rounds; at most two player turns each
request_accounting: before each transport attempt, including preflight and repair; cumulative across stages and sides
purity: strict; no fallback; no experimental retries
progression: continue independent matches after ordinary provider failures; disable provider at request ceiling or failed preflight
integrity: stop all providers on source mutation, provenance violation, catalog execution defect or replay mismatch
partial_state: request ceiling preserves exact prefix without automatic EndTurn
replay: complete command trace and detached per-turn model observations, catalogs, AP and heuristic execution
